name: Praise Team Members
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of sanctifying oneself and offering skillful, joyful praise to the Lord, as seen in Joshua's call to holiness before God’s wondrous works (Joshua 3:5) and the Psalms' exhortations to sing new songs and make joyful noise to the rock of our salvation (Psalms 33:3; 95:1). Praise team members are called to bless the Lord wholeheartedly, expressing reverence and worship through both voice and instrument in God’s sanctuary (Psalms 103:1; 150:1). Their service is not merely performance but a sincere offering from the heart, which God searches and evaluates according to each person’s faithfulness (Jeremiah 17:10).
